title: Prospective Late-Opening Move-Ordering Causal Anatomy, Same-Position Cross-Engine Witness Expansion, Search-Lineage Localization, Patch-Level Regression Replay & Developer-Facing TT Decision Diagnostics

program_identity.primary_question: Within fresh late-opening worlds, which prospectively defined MOVE_ORDER_SEED search-lineage archetypes repeatedly produce exact-intervention root-move changes across engines, positions and sources?
program_identity.engineering_question: Can the P9 exact witness bank be replayed byte-identically as a baseline regression harness that future engine patches can consume?
program_identity.terminal_product: Fresh causal-lineage anatomy plus a replayable TT decision regression manifest and developer diagnostic.

harvest_bridge.rule: Harvest may motivate lineage and regression organization but cannot strengthen fresh P10 chess authority.

fresh_sources.freshness_rule: Exclude every recoverable P1-P9 candidate FEN hash before admission; exclude cross-source duplicates; P9 positive positions are forbidden.

late_opening_worlds.position_choice: Among eligible late-opening positions in each of the first 1,024 source games, select the three lexicographically smallest fresh trajectory-position hashes after historical exclusion.

strata.predicate: no prior event in baseline prefix has the same TT key
at least one prior event in baseline prefix has the same TT key

lineage.causal_prior_semantics: All primary archetype atoms are computed from the baseline trace at or before the addressed event; raw TT key may be used transiently only for within-trace equality.

p9_regression_seed_lane.replay_positive: Re-run each P9 positive exact address on the original pinned engine binary and require target fired plus the exact recorded baseline→counterfactual bestmove transition.
p9_regression_seed_lane.replay_control: Where a matched negative control exists, re-run its exact address and require target fired plus no baseline root-move change.
p9_regression_seed_lane.success_rule: All replayable positive cases must reproduce exactly; every present matched control must remain negative.

implementation_roles.Python: Fresh PGN late-opening corpus, exact replay, baseline-prefix lineage atoms, PV/chess phenotype and regression harness.
implementation_roles.Rust: Deterministic fresh anatomy aggregation, support gate and replicated-archetype compiler.
implementation_roles.Go: Independent anatomy aggregation and archetype parity verifier.

stop_rule: If fresh corpus cannot be materialized, close CORPUS_HOLD.
If fresh causal support gate fails, close P10_FRESH_SUPPORT_HOLD; do not invent new lineage atoms.
If support passes, evaluate frozen A0 rule exactly once; A1 remains diagnostic only.
Regression seed replay is engineering reproduction and cannot rescue failed fresh anatomy.
P10 closes after fresh anatomy and baseline regression-harness materialization; it does not grow a new representation family.
claim_ceiling: P10 fresh anatomy is specific to late-opening worlds, exact MOVE_ORDER_SEED intervention, the declared engines, node budget and sampler.
P9 target labels and regression witnesses receive zero P10 fresh confirmatory vote.
Raw TT key equality is only an intra-trace lineage relation and never a cross-engine identity claim.
A replicated A0 archetype is a developer-facing structural regularity, not a universal causal essence of move ordering.
Baseline regression replay validates harness reproducibility, not persistence under an untested future patch.
No human strategic intent, Elo, playing strength or universal opening law is authorized.
